# Data Setup
```{r data_setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(here)

set.seed(42)  # global random seed

# --- LOAD AND JOIN CSVs -------------------------------------------------------

# Read both CSV files
values_raw <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "train_values.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE)

labels_raw <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "train_labels.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE)

# Join as tibble
data <- values_raw |>
  inner_join(labels_raw, by = "building_id", relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  as_tibble()

# Throws an error if any rows are dropped
stopifnot(nrow(data) == nrow(values_raw))

# Save to "data/processed" for further processing and modeling
saveRDS(data, here("data", "processed", "earthquake.rds"))
```

# Preprocessing
``` {r preprocessing}

# --- PREPROCESSING ------------------------------------------------------------

# Load the full (joined) dataset
data <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "earthquake.rds"))

# Convert outcome to a labeled categorical factor
data <- data |>
  mutate(
    damage_grade = factor(
      damage_grade, 
      levels = c(3, 2, 1), 
      labels = c("high", "medium", "low"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

# Convert other categoricals to factors
data <- data |>
  mutate(across(c(where(is_character), geo_level_1_id), as.factor))


# --- SPLITS -------------------------------------------------------------------

eq_split <- initial_split(data, prop = 0.80, strata = damage_grade)
train_data <- training(eq_split)
test_data  <- testing(eq_split)

# 5-fold stratified CV
folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 5, strata = damage_grade)


# --- RECIPE -------------------------------------------------------------------

base_recipe <- recipe(damage_grade ~ ., data = train_data) |>
  update_role(building_id, new_role = "id") |>
  step_rm(has_secondary_use, geo_level_2_id, geo_level_3_id) |>
  step_novel(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = FALSE) |>  # no one_hot prevents multicollinearity
  step_zv(all_predictors()) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
```

# Elastic Net

```{r}
# Reusable helpers for Gina Mancuso's geographic elastic-net candidate.
#
# These functions implement moderate case weighting, hierarchical geographic
# likelihood encoding, cross-fitting, model preprocessing, and diagnostics.
# All outcome-based geographic features must be constructed from an explicit
# reference data set so that assessment or holdout outcomes are never used.

add_power_weights <- function(data, reference_data, power) {
  weight_lookup <- reference_data |>
    count(damage_grade, name = "class_n") |>
    mutate(
      balanced_weight = nrow(reference_data) /
        (n_distinct(reference_data$damage_grade) * class_n),
      case_weight = balanced_weight^power
    )

  weight_values <- weight_lookup$case_weight[
    match(data$damage_grade, weight_lookup$damage_grade)
  ]

  data |>
    mutate(class_weights = importance_weights(weight_values))
}


class_count_table <- function(data, group_variables) {
  data |>
    mutate(.damage_class = as.character(damage_grade)) |>
    count(across(all_of(group_variables)), .damage_class) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = .damage_class,
      values_from = n,
      names_prefix = "count_",
      values_fill = 0
    ) |>
    mutate(
      count_low = coalesce(count_low, 0L),
      count_medium = coalesce(count_medium, 0L),
      count_high = coalesce(count_high, 0L),
      observations = count_low + count_medium + count_high
    )
}


build_geography_maps <- function(reference_data, prior_n) {
  global_probabilities <- tibble(
    probability_low = mean(as.character(reference_data$damage_grade) == "low"),
    probability_medium = mean(
      as.character(reference_data$damage_grade) == "medium"
    ),
    probability_high = mean(
      as.character(reference_data$damage_grade) == "high"
    )
  )

  level_1_map <- class_count_table(reference_data, "geo_level_1_id") |>
    mutate(
      probability_low = (
        count_low + prior_n * global_probabilities$probability_low
      ) / (observations + prior_n),
      probability_medium = (
        count_medium + prior_n * global_probabilities$probability_medium
      ) / (observations + prior_n),
      probability_high = (
        count_high + prior_n * global_probabilities$probability_high
      ) / (observations + prior_n)
    ) |>
    select(geo_level_1_id, starts_with("probability_"))

  level_2_parent <- reference_data |>
    distinct(geo_level_2_id, geo_level_1_id)

  if (anyDuplicated(level_2_parent$geo_level_2_id)) {
    stop("A level-2 ID maps to multiple level-1 parents.")
  }

  level_2_map <- class_count_table(reference_data, "geo_level_2_id") |>
    left_join(level_2_parent, by = "geo_level_2_id") |>
    left_join(
      level_1_map |>
        rename(
          parent_probability_low = probability_low,
          parent_probability_medium = probability_medium,
          parent_probability_high = probability_high
        ),
      by = "geo_level_1_id"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      probability_low = (
        count_low + prior_n * parent_probability_low
      ) / (observations + prior_n),
      probability_medium = (
        count_medium + prior_n * parent_probability_medium
      ) / (observations + prior_n),
      probability_high = (
        count_high + prior_n * parent_probability_high
      ) / (observations + prior_n)
    ) |>
    select(
      geo_level_2_id,
      geo_level_1_id,
      starts_with("probability_")
    )

  level_3_parent <- reference_data |>
    distinct(geo_level_3_id, geo_level_2_id, geo_level_1_id)

  if (anyDuplicated(level_3_parent$geo_level_3_id)) {
    stop("A level-3 ID maps to multiple geographic parents.")
  }

  level_3_map <- class_count_table(reference_data, "geo_level_3_id") |>
    left_join(level_3_parent, by = "geo_level_3_id") |>
    left_join(
      level_2_map |>
        select(geo_level_2_id, starts_with("probability_")) |>
        rename(
          parent_probability_low = probability_low,
          parent_probability_medium = probability_medium,
          parent_probability_high = probability_high
        ),
      by = "geo_level_2_id"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      probability_low = (
        count_low + prior_n * parent_probability_low
      ) / (observations + prior_n),
      probability_medium = (
        count_medium + prior_n * parent_probability_medium
      ) / (observations + prior_n),
      probability_high = (
        count_high + prior_n * parent_probability_high
      ) / (observations + prior_n)
    ) |>
    select(
      geo_level_3_id,
      geo_level_2_id,
      geo_level_1_id,
      starts_with("probability_")
    )

  list(
    global = global_probabilities,
    level_1 = level_1_map,
    level_2 = level_2_map,
    level_3 = level_3_map,
    prior_n = prior_n
  )
}


apply_geography_maps <- function(new_data, maps) {
  new_data |>
    left_join(
      maps$level_1 |>
        rename(
          geo1_probability_low = probability_low,
          geo1_probability_medium = probability_medium,
          geo1_probability_high = probability_high
        ),
      by = "geo_level_1_id"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      geo1_probability_low = coalesce(
        geo1_probability_low,
        maps$global$probability_low
      ),
      geo1_probability_medium = coalesce(
        geo1_probability_medium,
        maps$global$probability_medium
      ),
      geo1_probability_high = coalesce(
        geo1_probability_high,
        maps$global$probability_high
      )
    ) |>
    left_join(
      maps$level_2 |>
        select(geo_level_2_id, starts_with("probability_")) |>
        rename(
          geo2_probability_low = probability_low,
          geo2_probability_medium = probability_medium,
          geo2_probability_high = probability_high
        ),
      by = "geo_level_2_id"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      geo2_probability_low = coalesce(
        geo2_probability_low,
        geo1_probability_low
      ),
      geo2_probability_medium = coalesce(
        geo2_probability_medium,
        geo1_probability_medium
      ),
      geo2_probability_high = coalesce(
        geo2_probability_high,
        geo1_probability_high
      )
    ) |>
    left_join(
      maps$level_3 |>
        select(geo_level_3_id, starts_with("probability_")) |>
        rename(
          geo3_probability_low = probability_low,
          geo3_probability_medium = probability_medium,
          geo3_probability_high = probability_high
        ),
      by = "geo_level_3_id"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      geo3_probability_low = coalesce(
        geo3_probability_low,
        geo2_probability_low
      ),
      geo3_probability_medium = coalesce(
        geo3_probability_medium,
        geo2_probability_medium
      ),
      geo3_probability_high = coalesce(
        geo3_probability_high,
        geo2_probability_high
      )
    ) |>
    # Medium probability is implied by low + medium + high = 1, so retaining
    # only low and high avoids exact linear dependence.
    select(
      -starts_with("geo1_probability_"),
      -geo2_probability_medium,
      -geo3_probability_medium
    )
}


crossfit_geography <- function(
  analysis_data,
  prior_n,
  v,
  seed
) {
  indexed_analysis <- analysis_data |>
    mutate(.geography_row_id = row_number())

  set.seed(seed)
  encoding_folds <- vfold_cv(
    indexed_analysis,
    v = v,
    strata = damage_grade
  )

  crossfit_features <- map_dfr(
    encoding_folds$splits,
    function(encoding_split) {
      encoding_reference <- analysis(encoding_split)
      encoding_assessment <- assessment(encoding_split)
      encoding_maps <- build_geography_maps(
        encoding_reference,
        prior_n = prior_n
      )

      apply_geography_maps(encoding_assessment, encoding_maps) |>
        select(
          .geography_row_id,
          matches("^geo[23]_probability_(low|high)$")
        )
    }
  )

  if (
    nrow(crossfit_features) != nrow(indexed_analysis) ||
      anyDuplicated(crossfit_features$.geography_row_id)
  ) {
    stop("Cross-fitting did not return exactly one row per analysis building.")
  }

  encoded_analysis <- indexed_analysis |>
    left_join(crossfit_features, by = ".geography_row_id") |>
    select(-.geography_row_id)

  encoded_columns <- c(
    "geo2_probability_low",
    "geo2_probability_high",
    "geo3_probability_low",
    "geo3_probability_high"
  )

  if (anyNA(encoded_analysis[encoded_columns])) {
    stop("Cross-fitted geographic features contain missing values.")
  }

  encoded_analysis
}


make_geographic_recipe <- function(weighted_analysis_data) {
  recipe(damage_grade ~ ., data = weighted_analysis_data) |>
    update_role(building_id, new_role = "id") |>
    step_rm(has_secondary_use, geo_level_2_id, geo_level_3_id) |>
    step_novel(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = FALSE) |>
    step_zv(all_predictors()) |>
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
}


geographic_class_metrics <- function(predictions) {
  map_dfr(
    levels(predictions$damage_grade),
    function(class_level) {
      truth_binary <- factor(
        predictions$damage_grade == class_level,
        levels = c(TRUE, FALSE)
      )
      estimate_binary <- factor(
        predictions$.pred_class == class_level,
        levels = c(TRUE, FALSE)
      )

      tibble(
        class = class_level,
        support = sum(predictions$damage_grade == class_level),
        predicted = sum(predictions$.pred_class == class_level),
        precision = precision_vec(
          truth_binary,
          estimate_binary,
          event_level = "first"
        ),
        recall = recall_vec(
          truth_binary,
          estimate_binary,
          event_level = "first"
        ),
        f1 = f_meas_vec(
          truth_binary,
          estimate_binary,
          event_level = "first"
        )
      )
    }
  )
}


geographic_overall_metrics <- function(predictions) {
  qwk <- metric_tweak("qwk", kap, weighting = "quadratic")
  f_macro <- metric_tweak("f_macro", f_meas, estimator = "macro")
  metric_functions <- metric_set(qwk, f_macro, bal_accuracy, accuracy)
  per_class <- geographic_class_metrics(predictions)

  metric_functions(
    predictions,
    truth = damage_grade,
    estimate = .pred_class
  ) |>
    bind_rows(
      tibble(
        .metric = "macro_recall",
        .estimator = "macro",
        .estimate = mean(per_class$recall)
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Gina Mancuso: training-only ordinal elastic-net sensitivity experiment
#
# This script compares the current multinomial geographic elastic-net candidate
# with a parallel cumulative-logit elastic net. The ordinal model learns one
# shared predictor direction and two ordered cut points for low < medium < high.
#
# IMPORTANT: This experiment never extracts, accesses, or evaluates the shared
# holdout. The shared .RData container is loaded into an isolated environment,
# and only the training data and resampling folds are copied out.

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(ordinalNet)
library(here)

source(here("models", "mancuso_geography_helpers.R"))

set.seed(42)


# --- TRAINING-ONLY CONFIGURATION --------------------------------------------

experiment_parameters <- list(
  weight_power = 0.5,
  smoothing_strength = 10,
  inner_encoding_folds = 5,
  mixture = 0.5,
  penalty_grid = c(0.0001, 0.0003, 0.001, 0.003, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1),
  seed = 42,
  outcome_order = c("low", "medium", "high")
)


# --- LOAD ONLY TRAINING OBJECTS ---------------------------------------------

split_path <- here("data", "processed", "split_data.RData")

if (!file.exists(split_path)) {
  stop(
    "The shared split file does not exist. Run shared/01_data_setup.R and ",
    "shared/02_preprocessing.R before this experiment."
  )
}

shared_objects <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
load(split_path, envir = shared_objects)

required_objects <- c("folds", "train_data")
missing_objects <- required_objects[!vapply(
  required_objects,
  exists,
  logical(1),
  envir = shared_objects,
  inherits = FALSE
)]

if (length(missing_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The shared split file is missing required objects: ",
    paste(missing_objects, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

folds <- shared_objects$folds
train_data <- shared_objects$train_data
rm(shared_objects)

message("Running the training-only ordinal elastic-net experiment.")
message(sprintf(
  "Training rows: %s; outer CV folds: %s; holdout accessed: FALSE",
  format(nrow(train_data), big.mark = ","),
  nrow(folds)
))


# --- ORDINAL MODEL HELPERS ---------------------------------------------------

make_weighted_ordinal_response <- function(outcome, case_weights, levels) {
  outcome_index <- match(as.character(outcome), levels)

  if (anyNA(outcome_index)) {
    stop("The ordinal response contains an unexpected damage class.")
  }

  response <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = length(outcome_index),
    ncol = length(levels),
    dimnames = list(NULL, levels)
  )
  response[cbind(seq_along(outcome_index), outcome_index)] <- as.numeric(
    case_weights
  )
  response
}


prepare_ordinal_matrices <- function(
  weighted_analysis,
  encoded_assessment,
  outcome_order
) {
  preprocessing <- make_geographic_recipe(weighted_analysis) |>
    prep(training = weighted_analysis, retain = TRUE)

  baked_analysis <- bake(preprocessing, new_data = NULL)
  baked_assessment <- bake(preprocessing, new_data = encoded_assessment)

  predictor_names <- summary(preprocessing) |>
    filter(role == "predictor") |>
    pull(variable)

  if (length(predictor_names) == 0) {
    stop("The ordinal preprocessing recipe produced no predictors.")
  }

  list(
    x_analysis = as.matrix(
      baked_analysis |>
        select(all_of(predictor_names))
    ),
    x_assessment = as.matrix(
      baked_assessment |>
        select(all_of(predictor_names))
    ),
    y_analysis = make_weighted_ordinal_response(
      outcome = weighted_analysis$damage_grade,
      case_weights = weighted_analysis$class_weights,
      levels = outcome_order
    )
  )
}


predict_ordinal_path <- function(
  ordinal_fit,
  x_assessment,
  assessment_data,
  fold_id,
  outcome_order
) {
  map_dfr(
    seq_along(ordinal_fit$lambdaVals),
    function(lambda_index) {
      probabilities <- predict(
        ordinal_fit,
        newx = x_assessment,
        whichLambda = lambda_index,
        type = "response"
      )

      if (ncol(probabilities) != length(outcome_order)) {
        stop("The ordinal model returned an unexpected probability matrix.")
      }

      colnames(probabilities) <- paste0(".pred_", outcome_order)
      predicted_level <- outcome_order[max.col(probabilities, ties.method = "first")]

      bind_cols(
        assessment_data |>
          select(building_id, damage_grade),
        tibble(
          .pred_class = factor(
            predicted_level,
            levels = levels(assessment_data$damage_grade)
          )
        ),
        as_tibble(probabilities)
      ) |>
        mutate(
          fold = fold_id,
          penalty = ordinal_fit$lambdaVals[[lambda_index]],
          .before = 1
        )
    }
  )
}


severe_error_summary <- function(predictions) {
  predictions |>
    summarise(
      observations = n(),
      low_to_high = sum(
        as.character(damage_grade) == "low" &
          as.character(.pred_class) == "high"
      ),
      high_to_low = sum(
        as.character(damage_grade) == "high" &
          as.character(.pred_class) == "low"
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(
      severe_errors = low_to_high + high_to_low,
      severe_error_rate = severe_errors / observations
    )
}


# --- FIT THE ORDINAL PATH IN EACH SHARED OUTER FOLD -------------------------

ordinal_predictions <- map2_dfr(
  folds$splits,
  seq_len(nrow(folds)),
  function(split_object, fold_number) {
    fold_id <- folds$id[[fold_number]]
    message("  Preparing ", fold_id, " of ", nrow(folds))

    outer_analysis <- analysis(split_object)
    outer_assessment <- assessment(split_object)

    encoded_analysis <- crossfit_geography(
      analysis_data = outer_analysis,
      prior_n = experiment_parameters$smoothing_strength,
      v = experiment_parameters$inner_encoding_folds,
      seed = 12000 + fold_number
    )

    outer_maps <- build_geography_maps(
      reference_data = outer_analysis,
      prior_n = experiment_parameters$smoothing_strength
    )
    encoded_assessment <- apply_geography_maps(
      new_data = outer_assessment,
      maps = outer_maps
    )

    weighted_analysis <- add_power_weights(
      data = encoded_analysis,
      reference_data = encoded_analysis,
      power = experiment_parameters$weight_power
    )

    ordinal_data <- prepare_ordinal_matrices(
      weighted_analysis = weighted_analysis,
      encoded_assessment = encoded_assessment,
      outcome_order = experiment_parameters$outcome_order
    )

    message(
      "  Fitting ordinal path for ", fold_id,
      " (", ncol(ordinal_data$x_analysis), " predictors)"
    )

    ordinal_fit <- ordinalNet(
      x = ordinal_data$x_analysis,
      y = ordinal_data$y_analysis,
      alpha = experiment_parameters$mixture,
      standardize = FALSE,
      family = "cumulative",
      link = "logit",
      parallelTerms = TRUE,
      nonparallelTerms = FALSE,
      lambdaVals = experiment_parameters$penalty_grid,
      keepTrainingData = FALSE
    )

    predict_ordinal_path(
      ordinal_fit = ordinal_fit,
      x_assessment = ordinal_data$x_assessment,
      assessment_data = outer_assessment,
      fold_id = fold_id,
      outcome_order = experiment_parameters$outcome_order
    )
  }
)


# --- SELECT THE PENALTY USING TRAINING-ONLY CROSS-VALIDATION ----------------

ordinal_fold_metrics <- ordinal_predictions |>
  group_by(penalty, fold) |>
  group_modify(
    ~ geographic_overall_metrics(.x) |>
      select(.metric, .estimator, .estimate)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

ordinal_qwk_summary <- ordinal_fold_metrics |>
  filter(.metric == "qwk") |>
  group_by(penalty) |>
  summarise(
    mean_qwk = mean(.estimate),
    sd_qwk = sd(.estimate),
    se_qwk = sd_qwk / sqrt(n()),
    folds = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(mean_qwk))

best_numeric <- ordinal_qwk_summary |>
  slice_max(mean_qwk, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

one_se_cutoff <- best_numeric$mean_qwk - best_numeric$se_qwk

selected_ordinal <- ordinal_qwk_summary |>
  filter(mean_qwk >= one_se_cutoff) |>
  slice_max(penalty, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    selection_rule = "largest penalty within one SE of best mean QWK",
    best_mean_qwk = best_numeric$mean_qwk,
    best_penalty = best_numeric$penalty,
    one_se_cutoff = one_se_cutoff
  )

selected_penalty <- selected_ordinal$penalty[[1]]

if (selected_penalty %in% range(experiment_parameters$penalty_grid)) {
  warning(
    "The selected ordinal penalty lies on the search boundary. Interpret ",
    "the experiment as sensitivity evidence rather than final tuning."
  )
}

selected_predictions <- ordinal_predictions |>
  filter(near(penalty, selected_penalty))

ordinal_overall <- geographic_overall_metrics(selected_predictions)
ordinal_per_class <- geographic_class_metrics(selected_predictions)
ordinal_severe <- severe_error_summary(selected_predictions)

ordinal_confusion <- conf_mat(
  selected_predictions,
  truth = damage_grade,
  estimate = .pred_class
)

ordinal_confusion_long <- as.data.frame(ordinal_confusion$table) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  group_by(Truth) |>
  mutate(row_percent = 100 * Freq / sum(Freq)) |>
  ungroup()


# --- COMPARE WITH THE LOCKED MULTINOMIAL CANDIDATE --------------------------

metrics_dir <- here("results", "metrics")
figures_dir <- here("results", "figures")
dir.create(metrics_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

candidate_overall_path <- file.path(
  metrics_dir,

)
candidate_class_path <- file.path(

  "elastic_net_geographic_candidate_oof_per_class.csv"
)
candidate_confusion_path <- file.path(
  metrics_dir,
  "elastic_net_geographic_candidate_confusion.csv"
)
candidate_fold_path <- file.path(
  metrics_dir,
  "elastic_net_geographic_candidate_fold_metrics.csv"
)

comparison_files <- c(
  candidate_overall_path,
  candidate_class_path,
  candidate_confusion_path,
  candidate_fold_path
)

if (!all(file.exists(comparison_files))) {
  stop(
    "Run models/mancuso_geographic_elastic_net_candidate.R before the ordinal ",
    "comparison so its training-only metrics are available."
  )
}

candidate_overall <- read_csv(candidate_overall_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
candidate_per_class <- read_csv(candidate_class_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
candidate_confusion <- read_csv(candidate_confusion_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
candidate_fold_metrics <- read_csv(candidate_fold_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

candidate_severe <- candidate_confusion |>
  summarise(
    observations = sum(Freq),
    low_to_high = sum(Freq[Truth == "low" & Prediction == "high"]),
    high_to_low = sum(Freq[Truth == "high" & Prediction == "low"])
  ) |>
  mutate(
    severe_errors = low_to_high + high_to_low,
    severe_error_rate = severe_errors / observations
  )

overall_comparison <- bind_rows(
  candidate_overall |>
    mutate(model = "Multinomial candidate"),
  ordinal_overall |>
    mutate(model = "Ordinal sensitivity")
) |>
  select(model, everything())

class_comparison <- bind_rows(
  candidate_per_class |>
    mutate(model = "Multinomial candidate"),
  ordinal_per_class |>
    mutate(model = "Ordinal sensitivity")
) |>
  select(model, everything())

severe_comparison <- bind_rows(
  candidate_severe |>
    mutate(model = "Multinomial candidate"),
  ordinal_severe |>
    mutate(model = "Ordinal sensitivity")
) |>
  select(model, everything())

fold_qwk_comparison <- candidate_fold_metrics |>
  filter(.metric == "qwk") |>
  select(fold, multinomial_qwk = .estimate) |>
  inner_join(
    ordinal_fold_metrics |>
      filter(.metric == "qwk", near(penalty, selected_penalty)) |>
      select(fold, ordinal_qwk = .estimate),
    by = "fold"
  ) |>
  mutate(qwk_difference = ordinal_qwk - multinomial_qwk)

paired_qwk_summary <- fold_qwk_comparison |>
  summarise(
    mean_multinomial_qwk = mean(multinomial_qwk),
    mean_ordinal_qwk = mean(ordinal_qwk),
    mean_qwk_difference = mean(qwk_difference),
    folds_improved = sum(qwk_difference > 0),
    folds_total = n()
  )


# --- SAVE TRAINING-ONLY OUTPUTS ---------------------------------------------

parameter_table <- tibble(

write_csv(

saveRDS(

tuning_plot <- ordinal_qwk_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = penalty, y = mean_qwk)) +
```

```{r}
# Gina Mancuso: final training-only geographic elastic-net candidate
#
# Selected training configuration:
#   - moderate square-root inverse-frequency case weights
#   - fold-safe hierarchical level-2 and level-3 likelihood encoding
#   - smoothing strength 10
#   - penalty 0.003 and mixture 0.5
#
# The script reproduces five-fold out-of-fold diagnostics and saves a complete
# full-training model bundle for future prediction. The shared holdout is not
# accessed unless evaluate_holdout is deliberately changed to TRUE after group
# model selection is complete.

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(here)

source(here("models", "mancuso_geography_helpers.R"))

set.seed(42)


# --- LOCKED CONFIGURATION ----------------------------------------------------

evaluate_holdout <- FALSE

candidate_parameters <- list(
  weight_power = 0.5,
  smoothing_strength = 10,
  inner_encoding_folds = 5,
  penalty = 0.003,
  mixture = 0.5,
  seed = 42
)


# --- LOAD SHARED OBJECTS WITHOUT EXPOSING THE HOLDOUT -----------------------

split_path <- here("data", "processed", "split_data.RData")

if (!file.exists(split_path)) {
  stop(
    "The shared split file does not exist. Run shared/01_data_setup.R and ",
    "shared/02_preprocessing.R before this candidate."
  )
}

shared_objects <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
load(split_path, envir = shared_objects)

required_objects <- c("folds", "train_data")
if (evaluate_holdout) {
  required_objects <- c(required_objects, "test_data")
}

missing_objects <- required_objects[!vapply(
  required_objects,
  exists,
  logical(1),
  envir = shared_objects,
  inherits = FALSE
)]

if (length(missing_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The shared split file is missing required objects: ",
    paste(missing_objects, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

folds <- shared_objects$folds
train_data <- shared_objects$train_data

if (evaluate_holdout) {
  holdout_data <- shared_objects$test_data
}

rm(shared_objects)

message("Executing the locked geographic elastic-net candidate.")
message(sprintf(
  "Training rows: %s; outer CV folds: %s; holdout evaluation: %s",
  format(nrow(train_data), big.mark = ","),
  nrow(folds),
  evaluate_holdout
))


# --- MODEL SPECIFICATION -----------------------------------------------------

candidate_spec <- multinom_reg(
  penalty = candidate_parameters$penalty,
  mixture = candidate_parameters$mixture
) |>
  set_engine("glmnet", standardize = FALSE) |>
  set_mode("classification")


fit_candidate_workflow <- function(weighted_analysis_data) {
  workflow() |>
    add_recipe(make_geographic_recipe(weighted_analysis_data)) |>
    add_model(candidate_spec) |>
    add_case_weights(class_weights) |>
    fit(data = weighted_analysis_data)
}


# --- LEAKAGE-SAFE OUT-OF-FOLD DIAGNOSTICS -----------------------------------

oof_predictions <- map2_dfr(
  folds$splits,
  seq_len(nrow(folds)),
  function(split_object, fold_number) {
    fold_id <- folds$id[[fold_number]]
    message("  Fitting ", fold_id, " of ", nrow(folds))

    outer_analysis <- analysis(split_object)
    outer_assessment <- assessment(split_object)

    encoded_analysis <- crossfit_geography(
      analysis_data = outer_analysis,
      prior_n = candidate_parameters$smoothing_strength,
      v = candidate_parameters$inner_encoding_folds,
      seed = 4200 + fold_number
    )

    outer_maps <- build_geography_maps(
      reference_data = outer_analysis,
      prior_n = candidate_parameters$smoothing_strength
    )
    encoded_assessment <- apply_geography_maps(
      new_data = outer_assessment,
      maps = outer_maps
    )

    weighted_analysis <- add_power_weights(
      data = encoded_analysis,
      reference_data = encoded_analysis,
      power = candidate_parameters$weight_power
    )

    fold_fit <- fit_candidate_workflow(weighted_analysis)

    class_predictions <- predict(
      fold_fit,
      new_data = encoded_assessment,
      type = "class"
    )
    probability_predictions <- predict(
      fold_fit,
      new_data = encoded_assessment,
      type = "prob"
    )

    bind_cols(
      encoded_assessment |>
        select(building_id, damage_grade),
      class_predictions,
      probability_predictions
    ) |>
      mutate(fold = fold_id, .before = 1)
  }
)

oof_overall <- geographic_overall_metrics(oof_predictions)
oof_per_class <- geographic_class_metrics(oof_predictions)

oof_fold_metrics <- oof_predictions |>
  group_by(fold) |>
  group_modify(
    ~ geographic_overall_metrics(.x) |>
      select(.metric, .estimator, .estimate)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

oof_fold_class_metrics <- oof_predictions |>
  group_by(fold) |>
  group_modify(~ geographic_class_metrics(.x)) |>
  ungroup()

oof_confusion <- conf_mat(
  oof_predictions,
  truth = damage_grade,
  estimate = .pred_class
)

oof_confusion_long <- as.data.frame(oof_confusion$table) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  group_by(Truth) |>
  mutate(row_percent = 100 * Freq / sum(Freq)) |>
  ungroup()


# --- FULL-TRAINING FIT FOR FUTURE PREDICTION --------------------------------

# Cross-fitted encodings prevent each training building's own outcome from
# contributing to its model input. Separate maps built from all training rows
# are saved only for encoding genuinely new data later.
message("Building the full-training candidate bundle.")

full_training_encoded <- crossfit_geography(
  analysis_data = train_data,
  prior_n = candidate_parameters$smoothing_strength,
  v = candidate_parameters$inner_encoding_folds,
  seed = 9900 + candidate_parameters$seed
)

full_geography_maps <- build_geography_maps(
  reference_data = train_data,
  prior_n = candidate_parameters$smoothing_strength
)

full_training_weighted <- add_power_weights(
  data = full_training_encoded,
  reference_data = full_training_encoded,
  power = candidate_parameters$weight_power
)

full_training_fit <- fit_candidate_workflow(full_training_weighted)

class_weight_summary <- full_training_weighted |>
  as_tibble() |>
  group_by(damage_grade) |>
  summarise(
    observations = n(),
    observed_percent = 100 * n() / nrow(full_training_weighted),
    case_weight = as.numeric(first(class_weights)),
    weighted_total = sum(as.numeric(class_weights)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

candidate_bundle <- list(
  workflow_fit = full_training_fit,
  geography_maps = full_geography_maps,
  parameters = candidate_parameters,
  outcome_levels = levels(train_data$damage_grade),
  training_rows = nrow(train_data),
  created_at = Sys.time(),
  session_info = sessionInfo()
)


# --- SAVE TRAINING-ONLY REVIEW OUTPUTS --------------------------------------

metrics_dir <- here("results", "metrics")
figures_dir <- here("results", "figures")
dir.create(metrics_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

parameter_table <- tibble(
  weight_power = candidate_parameters$weight_power,
  smoothing_strength = candidate_parameters$smoothing_strength,
  inner_encoding_folds = candidate_parameters$inner_encoding_folds,
  outer_validation_folds = nrow(folds),
  penalty = candidate_parameters$penalty,
  mixture = candidate_parameters$mixture,
  evaluate_holdout = evaluate_holdout
)

write_csv(
  parameter_table,
  file.path(metrics_dir, "elastic_net_geographic_candidate_parameters.csv")
)
write_csv(
  class_weight_summary,
  file.path(metrics_dir, "elastic_net_geographic_candidate_class_weights.csv")
)
write_csv(
  oof_overall,
  file.path(metrics_dir, "elastic_net_geographic_candidate_oof_metrics.csv")
)
write_csv(
  oof_per_class,
  file.path(metrics_dir, "elastic_net_geographic_candidate_oof_per_class.csv")
)
write_csv(
  oof_fold_metrics,
  file.path(metrics_dir, "elastic_net_geographic_candidate_fold_metrics.csv")
)
write_csv(
  oof_fold_class_metrics,
  file.path(metrics_dir, "elastic_net_geographic_candidate_fold_class_metrics.csv")
)
write_csv(
  oof_confusion_long,
  file.path(metrics_dir, "elastic_net_geographic_candidate_confusion.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  oof_predictions,
  file.path(metrics_dir, "elastic_net_geographic_candidate_oof_predictions.rds")
)
saveRDS(
  candidate_bundle,
  file.path(metrics_dir, "elastic_net_geographic_candidate_bundle.rds")
)

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  file.path(metrics_dir, "elastic_net_geographic_candidate_session_info.txt")
)


# --- OPTIONAL ONE-TIME HOLDOUT EVALUATION ----------------------------------

if (evaluate_holdout) {
  message("WARNING: evaluating the locked holdout.")

  encoded_holdout <- apply_geography_maps(
    new_data = holdout_data,
    maps = full_geography_maps
  )

  holdout_predictions <- bind_cols(
    holdout_data |>
      select(building_id, damage_grade),
    predict(full_training_fit, new_data = encoded_holdout, type = "class"),
    predict(full_training_fit, new_data = encoded_holdout, type = "prob")
  )

  holdout_overall <- geographic_overall_metrics(holdout_predictions)
  holdout_per_class <- geographic_class_metrics(holdout_predictions)

  write_csv(
    holdout_overall,
    file.path(metrics_dir, "elastic_net_geographic_candidate_holdout_metrics.csv")
  )
  write_csv(
    holdout_per_class,
    file.path(
      metrics_dir,
      "elastic_net_geographic_candidate_holdout_per_class.csv"
    )
  )
  saveRDS(
    holdout_predictions,
    file.path(
      metrics_dir,
      "elastic_net_geographic_candidate_holdout_predictions.rds"
    )
  )
}


# --- REVIEW FIGURES ----------------------------------------------------------

class_diagnostic_plot <- oof_per_class |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(precision, recall, f1),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = class, y = estimate, fill = metric)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Geographic elastic-net candidate: class diagnostics",
    subtitle = "Leakage-safe training-only out-of-fold predictions",
    x = "Damage class",
    y = "Estimate",
    fill = "Metric"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

confusion_plot <- oof_confusion_long |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Prediction, y = Truth, fill = row_percent)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", row_percent)), size = 4) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "Geographic elastic-net OOF confusion matrix",
    subtitle = "Percentages are calculated within each true damage class",
    x = "Predicted class",
    y = "True class",
    fill = "Row %"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

fold_qwk_plot <- oof_fold_metrics |>
  filter(.metric == "qwk") |>

  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

ggsave(
  file.path(figures_dir, "elastic_net_geographic_candidate_class_metrics.png"),
```

### Per-class CV metrics

Precision, recall, and F1 for each damage grade use pooled out-of-fold predictions from the shared folds.

```{r}
#| label: per-class-cv
cv_pred <- collect_predictions(log_reg_resamples)
cm_tbl <- conf_mat(cv_pred, damage_grade, estimate = .pred_class)$table

cv_per_class <- map_dfr(rownames(cm_tbl), function(cls) {
  tp <- cm_tbl[cls, cls]
  fp <- sum(cm_tbl[cls, ]) - tp
  fn <- sum(cm_tbl[, cls]) - tp
  tibble(
    class = cls,
    precision = tp / (tp + fp),
    recall = tp / (tp + fn),
    f_meas = 2 * tp / (2 * tp + fp + fn)
  )
})

cv_per_class
```

## Weighting

```{r}
weight_exponent <- 0.5
class_counts <- train_data |>
  count(damage_grade, name = "class_count")
weighted_train <- train_data |>
  left_join(class_counts, by = "damage_grade") |>
  mutate(case_weight = (nrow(train_data) / class_count)^weight_exponent,
    case_weight = hardhat::importance_weights(case_weight / mean(case_weight))) |>
  select(-class_count)

weighted_splits <- vector("list", nrow(folds))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(folds))) 
{
  split <- folds$splits[[i]]
  analysis_data <- analysis(split)
  class_counts <- analysis_data |>
    count(damage_grade, name = "class_count")
  analysis_data <- analysis_data |>
    left_join(class_counts, by = "damage_grade") |>
    mutate(case_weight = (nrow(analysis_data) / class_count)^weight_exponent,
      case_weight = hardhat::importance_weights(case_weight / mean(case_weight))) |>
    select(-class_count)
  assessment_data <- assessment(split) |>
    mutate(case_weight = hardhat::importance_weights(rep(1, n())))
  n_analysis <- nrow(analysis_data)
  weighted_splits[[i]] <- make_splits(list(analysis = seq_len(n_analysis),
    assessment = n_analysis + seq_len(nrow(assessment_data))),
    data = bind_rows(analysis_data, assessment_data))
}
weighted_folds <- manual_rset(weighted_splits, ids = folds$id)

weighted_recipe <- recipe(damage_grade ~ ., data = weighted_train) |>
  update_role(building_id, new_role = "id") |>
  step_rm(has_secondary_use, geo_level_2_id, geo_level_3_id) |>
  step_novel(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = FALSE) |>
  step_zv(all_predictors()) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
```

```{r}
initial_candidates <- 15

model_xgb_tune <- boost_tree(mode = "classification", trees = tune(),
  learn_rate = tune(), tree_depth = tune(), min_n = tune(),
  loss_reduction = tune(), sample_size = tune(), mtry = tune()) |>
  set_engine("xgboost", nthread = 1, counts = FALSE)

workflow_xgb_tune <- workflow() |>

  update(trees = trees(c(100, 1500)),
    learn_rate = learn_rate(log10(c(0.01, 0.20))),
    tree_depth = tree_depth(c(2, 14)),
    min_n = min_n(c(2, 30)),

set.seed(42)

  size = initial_candidates, type = "latin_hypercube")
initial_grid
```

# Random Forest
```{r}
# tidymodels and data management
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(here)

# parallelization
library(future)
library(doFuture)
library(future.callr) # More robust backend for Positron

# Setup ------------------------------------------------------------------------
message("Executing Random Forest pipeline.")

set.seed(42)
processed_path <- here("data", "processed", "earthquake.rds")
split_path <- here("data", "processed", "split_data.RData")

if (!file.exists(processed_path)) {
  source(here("shared", "01_data_setup.R"))
}

if (!file.exists(split_path)) {
  source(here("shared", "02_preprocessing.R"))
}

load(split_path)

# Increase the export memory limit to 2 GB to handle the large dataset
options(future.globals.maxSize = 2000 * 1024^2)

# Detect number of usable cores (leaving one for OS processes)
total_cores <- max(1, parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE) - 1)
registerDoFuture()

# We have 5 folds, so we never need more than 5 parallel workers during tuning
cv_workers <- min(5, total_cores)
worker_threads <- max(1, floor(total_cores / cv_workers))

# Use callr instead of multisession to bypass socket connection errors
plan(callr, workers = cv_workers)
message(paste("Active parallel workers:", nbrOfWorkers()))
message(sprintf("Assigned %d threads per worker.", worker_threads))


# Model Specification ----------------------------------------------------------

# Define class weights based on their inverse frequencies
rf_class_weights <- train_data |>
  count(damage_grade) |>
  mutate(weight = sum(n) / n) |> 
  arrange(damage_grade) |> 
  pull(weight)

# Initialize the model
base_rf_spec <- rand_forest(
  mtry  = tune(),
  trees = 100,    # small number of trees for tuning, will increase at final fit
  min_n = tune()
) |> set_mode("classification")

# Inject the weights so workers receive the raw numbers
rf_spec <- rlang::inject(
  set_engine(
    base_rf_spec,
    "ranger",
    num.threads   = worker_threads,
    importance    = "impurity",
    class.weights = !!rf_class_weights 
  )
)

# Tidymodels Workflow and Setup ------------------------------------------------
rf_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(base_recipe) |>
  add_model(rf_spec)

rf_params <- extract_parameter_set_dials(rf_wf) |>
  update(
    mtry  = mtry(range = c(5, 85)),
    min_n = min_n(range = c(5, 50))
  )

# Metrics & Controls -----------------------------------------------------------
qwk <- metric_tweak("qwk", kap, weighting = "quadratic")
f_micro <- metric_tweak("f_micro", f_meas, estimator = "micro")
custom_metrics <- metric_set(qwk, f_micro, accuracy)

ctrl_bayes <- control_bayes(
  save_pred     = TRUE,
  verbose       = TRUE,
  no_improve    = 10,
  seed          = 42,
  parallel_over = "resamples"
)


### Replaced with Bayesian hyperparameter optimization
####################################################
# ctrl_grid <- control_grid(
#   save_pred     = TRUE,
#   parallel_over = "everything"
# )

# Grid Search ------------------------------------------------------------------
# message("Executing Space-Filling Grid Search...")
# rf_grid_results <- tune_grid(
#   rf_wf,
#   resamples = folds,
#   grid      = grid_space_filling(rf_params, size = 15),
#   metrics   = custom_metrics,
#   control   = ctrl_grid
# )

# saveRDS(rf_grid_results, here("results", "metrics", "rf_grid_results.rds"))
####################################################


# Bayesian Tuning --------------------------------------------------------------
message("Tuning parameters...")
rf_bayes_results <- tune_bayes(
  rf_wf,
  resamples  = folds,
  param_info = rf_params,
  initial    = 5,
  iter       = 10,
  metrics    = custom_metrics,
  control    = ctrl_bayes
)

saveRDS(rf_bayes_results, here("results", "metrics", "rf_bayes_results.rds"))

# Final Fit --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clean up parallelization to maximize final training efficiency
plan(sequential)
registerDoSEQ()

best_params <- select_best(rf_bayes_results, metric = "qwk")

# Update model to 1000 trees for final fit
final_rf_spec <- rlang::inject(
  rf_spec |> 
    update(trees = 1000) |> 
    set_engine("ranger",
      num.threads   = total_cores,    # allocate all available cores for
      importance    = "impurity",     #   training, leaving one for OS
      class.weights = !!rf_class_weights)
)

# Finalize workflow with final model specification and tuned parameters
final_rf_wf <- rf_wf |> 
  update_model(final_rf_spec) |>
  finalize_workflow(best_params)

# Manually train on full training data and evaluate on test data
final_fit_model <- fit(final_rf_wf, data = train_data)
final_preds <- augment(final_fit_model, new_data = test_data)
final_metrics   <- custom_metrics(final_preds, truth = damage_grade, estimate = .pred_class)

saveRDS(final_fit_model, here("results", "metrics", "final_rf_model.rds"))
saveRDS(final_metrics, here("results", "metrics", "final_rf_metrics.rds"))

message("Random Forest pipeline complete.")
```


# Support Vector Machine
```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(tidyverse)
library(finetune) 
library(furrr)
library(here)

plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE))
options(future.globals.maxSize = 3000 * 1024^2)


# Settings

tune_prop <- 0.1        # share of training data used for tuning
final_fit_prop <- 1     # share of training data used for the final fit
use_cache <- TRUE       # cache fitted results as .rds files in results/metrics
cache_dir <- here("results", "metrics")
output_dir <- here("results", "metrics", "svm")


# Helpers

cached <- function(file, expr) {
  path <- file.path(cache_dir, file)
  if (use_cache && file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  result <- expr
  if (use_cache) saveRDS(result, path)
  result
}

# kernlab cannot combine class.weights with prob.model = TRUE.
# Weighted probabilities are made from the unweighted probability

reweight_probs <- function(preds, weights) {
  p <- sweep(as.matrix(preds[prob_cols]), 2, weights[lv], `*`)
  p <- p / rowSums(p)
  preds[prob_cols] <- as.data.frame(p)
  preds$.pred_class <- factor(lv[max.col(p, ties.method = "first")],
    levels = lv)
  preds
}

# kernlab bug: when its Platt line search stops early it prints
# "line search fails A B ..." and stores a vector instead of list(A, B) for
# that class pair, which breaks predict().

fit_with_platt_repair <- function(wf, data) {
  log <- capture.output(fitted <- fit(wf, data))
  pm <- extract_fit_engine(fitted)@prob.model
  broken <- which(!map_lgl(pm, is.list))
  if (length(broken) == 0) return(fitted)

  fails <- str_match_all(paste(log, collapse = " "),
    "line search fails\\s+(\\S+)\\s+(\\S+)")[[1]]
  stopifnot(nrow(fails) == length(broken))
  for (k in seq_along(broken)) {
    pm[[broken[k]]] <- list(A = as.numeric(fails[k, 2]),
      B = as.numeric(fails[k, 3]))
  }
  fitted$fit$fit$fit@prob.model <- pm
  message("Repaired Platt parameters for class pair(s): ",
    paste(broken, collapse = ", "))
  fitted
}

# Precision, recall and F1 for each class (one class vs the rest).
per_class_table <- function(preds) {
  map_dfr(lv, \(cl) {
    truth <- factor(preds$damage_grade == cl, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE))
    est <- factor(preds$.pred_class == cl, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE))
    tibble(class = cl,
      precision = precision_vec(truth, est),
      recall = recall_vec(truth, est),
      f1 = f_meas_vec(truth, est))
  })
}


# Data

if (!file.exists(here("data", "processed", "earthquake.rds"))) {
  source(here("shared", "01_data_setup.R"))
}
split_path <- here("data", "processed", "split_data.RData")
if (!file.exists(split_path)) {
  source(here("shared", "02_preprocessing.R"))
}
load(split_path)

lv <- levels(train_data$damage_grade)
prob_cols <- paste0(".pred_", lv)

set.seed(1)
tune_data <- training(initial_split(train_data, prop = tune_prop,
  strata = damage_grade))
set.seed(1)
resamples <- vfold_cv(tune_data, v = 5, strata = damage_grade)

# Class weights by inverse class frequency.
class_counts <- count(train_data, damage_grade)
class_weights <- setNames(
  nrow(train_data) / (nrow(class_counts) * class_counts$n),
  as.character(class_counts$damage_grade))

# Metrics
qwk <- metric_tweak("qwk", kap, weighting = "quadratic")
f_macro <- metric_tweak("f_macro", f_meas, estimator = "macro")
f_micro <- metric_tweak("f_micro", f_meas, estimator = "micro")
report_metrics <- metric_set(qwk, f_macro, f_micro, bal_accuracy, accuracy,
  roc_auc)


# Models
# Tuning runs without the probability model (prob.model = FALSE), models are selected by QWK, which only needs
# class predictions.

make_svm_wf <- function(kernel, weighted, prob = FALSE) {
  spec <- switch(kernel,
    rbf = svm_rbf(mode = "classification", rbf_sigma = tune(), cost = tune()),
    linear = svm_linear(mode = "classification", cost = tune()),
    poly = svm_poly(mode = "classification", cost = tune(), degree = 2,
      scale_factor = tune()))
  engine_args <- list(prob.model = prob, cache = 1000, tol = 0.01)
  if (weighted) engine_args$class.weights <- class_weights
  spec <- do.call(set_engine, c(list(spec, "kernlab"), engine_args))
  workflow() |> add_model(spec) |> add_recipe(base_recipe)
}

make_params <- function(kernel, wf) {
  params <- extract_parameter_set_dials(wf)
  switch(kernel,
    rbf = params |>
      update(rbf_sigma = rbf_sigma(c(-4, -1)), cost = cost(c(-2, 3))),
    linear = params |> update(cost = cost(c(-2, 3))),
    poly = params |> update(cost = cost(c(-2, 3))))
}

grid_size <- c(rbf = 20, linear = 10, poly = 20)


# Tuning
# Racing evaluates a in parallel and drops candidates that
# are significantly worse after the first 3 folds.

model_names <- c("rbf_none", "rbf_weighted", "linear_none",
  "linear_weighted", "poly_none", "poly_weighted")

tune_results <- list()
for (m in model_names) {
  kernel <- str_remove(m, "_.*")
  wf <- make_svm_wf(kernel, weighted = str_detect(m, "weighted"))
  set.seed(1)
  tune_results[[m]] <- cached(paste0("svm_race_", m, "_v4.rds"),
    tune_race_anova(wf, resamples = resamples, grid = grid_size[[kernel]],
      param_info = make_params(kernel, wf), metrics = metric_set(qwk),
      control = control_race(save_pred = TRUE,
        parallel_over = "everything")))
}

# Best CV QWK of each model; the highest is selected.
qwk_by_model <- imap_dfr(tune_results, \(res, m)
  show_best(res, metric = "qwk", n = 1) |> mutate(model = m)) |>
  arrange(desc(mean))
qwk_by_model |> select(model, mean, std_err)

best_model <- qwk_by_model$model[1]
best_kernel <- str_remove(best_model, "_.*")
best_weighted <- str_detect(best_model, "weighted")
best_parameter <- select_best(tune_results[[best_model]], metric = "qwk")
param_tag <- best_parameter |>
  select(-.config) |>
  unlist() |>
  signif(3) |>
  paste(collapse = "_")


# Selected model: CV with probabilities
# Refitted with the probability model (always unweighted, see
# reweight_probs()) for ROC AUC. The raw predictions are the unweighted
# baseline; the reweighted ones are the selected model.

best_prob_wf <- make_svm_wf(best_kernel, weighted = FALSE, prob = TRUE) |>
  finalize_workflow(best_parameter)

svm_cv <- cached(
  paste0("svm_cv_best_prob_", best_kernel, "_", param_tag, "_v5.rds"),
  fit_resamples(best_prob_wf, resamples, metrics = report_metrics,
    control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE)))

baseline_preds <- collect_predictions(svm_cv)
cv_preds <- if (best_weighted) {
  reweight_probs(baseline_preds, class_weights)
} else {
  baseline_preds
}


# Final model and holdout predictions

set.seed(1)
final_data <- if (final_fit_prop < 1) {
  training(initial_split(train_data, prop = final_fit_prop,
    strata = damage_grade))
} else {
  train_data
}

final_fit <- cached(
  paste0("svm_final_model_", best_kernel, "_", param_tag, "_",
    final_fit_prop, "_v6.rds"),
  fit_with_platt_repair(best_prob_wf, final_data))

# Prediction cost grows with the number of support vectors, so the holdout
# set is predicted in parallel chunks.
holdout_preds <- test_data |>
  split(ceiling(seq_len(nrow(test_data)) / 5000)) |>
  future_map(\(d) augment(final_fit, new_data = d),
    .options = furrr_options(packages = c("tidymodels", "kernlab"))) |>
  bind_rows()
plan(sequential)

if (best_weighted) {
  holdout_preds <- reweight_probs(holdout_preds, class_weights)
}


# Saved outputs

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

summarise_cv <- function(preds, label) {
  preds |>
    group_by(id) |>
    report_metrics(truth = damage_grade, all_of(prob_cols),
      estimate = .pred_class) |>
    group_by(.metric) |>
    summarize(mean = mean(.estimate),
      std_err = sd(.estimate) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(model = label, .before = 1)
}

selected_label <- paste0(
  if (best_weighted) "Class-weighted " else "Unweighted ",
  toupper(best_kernel), " SVM (",
  best_parameter |>
    select(-.config) |>
    imap_chr(\(v, p) paste(p, signif(v, 3))) |>
    paste(collapse = ", "),
  ")")

outputs <- list(
  cv_metrics = bind_rows(
    summarise_cv(baseline_preds, "Unweighted baseline"),
    summarise_cv(cv_preds, selected_label)),
  cv_per_class_metrics = per_class_table(cv_preds),
  best_parameters = best_parameter,
  holdout_metrics = report_metrics(holdout_preds, truth = damage_grade,
    all_of(prob_cols), estimate = .pred_class),
  per_class_metrics = per_class_table(holdout_preds))

iwalk(outputs, \(table, name) {
  print(table)
  write_csv(table, file.path(output_dir, paste0(name, ".csv")))
})

report_metrics         
summarise_cv(cv_preds, "check") 
read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "cv_metrics.csv"))
```
